text_block_list.text:
“—The momentous day of the Make Debut.
A typical Umamusume would arrive at the venue with plenty of time to spare, but...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer~, good morning~.
As usual, Mejiro Bright appeared at an unhurried pace. What's more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"This is 'Maki-chan'~
Today is a very important race day, so I thought she could watch over me~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"The other 'Q-chan'
is keeping watch at home~.
I wonder if she's taking a nap right about now~?"

Even as we engaged in such relaxed conversation,
post time drew near, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone~, I look forward to working with you
today~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!? A doll in the paddock,
seriously, you...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What are you playing at?
What kind of day do you think today is...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today is~ the fun and exciting
debut day, isn't it~? So~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would help you relax.
Please, everyone, join me and let us
slowly take our time enjoying ourselves~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... That's true...
When you put it that way, I kind of feel like it too...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Maybe we were being a bit too high-strung, huh... Ahaha..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, look. The murderous look in the
Umamusumes' eyes is fading away...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what are they talking about?
Their expression is gradually softening...
It seemed everyone was being drawn into Mejiro Bright's pace.
And while on standby for a while—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu~, it's going to be a fun race from here on~.
A race... So, therefore~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic, don't panic.
Just at my usual, steady pace...

She spoke to the doll as if soothing a child. But
her voice was... faintly trembling.

Mejiro Bright wasn't fooling around.
It was all in an effort to keep her composure as undisturbed as possible...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...? My dear Trainer?
Is something the matter~?
choice_data_list: No, let's just stay calm and take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Okay~.
Thank you very much~♪"

The young lady of the Mejiros smiled softly,
as if relieved.
